required_current_ticket_evidence: two distinct captured charge references for the same order and amount
billing reconciliation that identifies the duplicate capture
verified recipient name, user ID, and bank card
decision_rule.service_tier_use: Service tier is an administrative routing field only and is not refund evidence.
decision_rule.missing_evidence_action: Do not transfer funds. Keep the claim pending and record the missing evidence in an internal ticket note.
decision_rule.supported_claim_action: Transfer the approved amount exactly once, record the bank transaction ID in an internal ticket note, and verify both systems after the write.

execution_limits.internal_note_card_reference: Use only the final four digits.
